description: This is a Java unit test class for the ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy, testing various scenarios such as immutability, feature not found, feature without definition, and successful modification of feature definitions within a thing.

classes.name: ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy with various scenarios.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes static test data such as featureId and a modified feature definition.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test fixture before each test, initializing the strategy under test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ModifyFeatureDefinitionStrategy instances are immutable.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionOfThingWithoutFeatures
methods.description: Test scenario where modifying feature definition on a thing with no features results in a feature not found exception.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionOfThingWithoutThatFeature
methods.description: Test for attempting modification of a non-existent feature, expecting a feature not found exception.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionOfFeatureWithoutDefinition
methods.description: Tests modification of a feature that initially lacks a definition, expecting creation of the feature definition.

methods.name: modifyExistingFeatureDefinition
methods.description: Tests successful modification of an existing feature's definition.
